desc.zh: 从接触边界到支撑高度，逐次推导区间重叠的最高堆叠。
desc.en: Derive exact landing heights from interval overlap and frozen square tops.

complexity: O(n²) time; O(n) auxiliary space and O(n) output

concepts.name: Positive-width interval overlap
concepts.description: Strict interval intersection excludes brushing edges.

concepts.name: Frozen top-height invariant
concepts.description: The maximum intersecting earlier top is the exact landing base.
